what: The Versus queue ranks smallest first by the owner's rule: the fewest interactive elements on the home page (links, inputs, buttons, selects), the fewer bytes on a tie. tower-size.mjs now counts the controls of each site and re-reads every weighed row that has no count yet; the frontier scan writes controls and bytes too. Also lands the measured-only ranking that #1550 merged without its code: a default-bar loss no longer moves a site back, and the loop makes it a job to measure, not a fix.
